correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs code signatures as selected-edge incidence unions, derives disjoint P3 components from exactly one selected neighbor, proves at most one unused original vertex by domination and signature collision, derives the forced orientation with one unused vertex, and proves all surviving packings have distinct nonempty signatures. It counts spanning P3 factors and the two unmatched boundary families exactly. An independent direct-adjacency verifier exhaustively enumerated 1,501,038 subsets over 17 boards; all counts match. Finite tests are corroborative, not substitutes for proof.

evidence: Seo–Slater 2017, Theorem 3.3: a sufficient local condition assumes girth at least five; the rook graphs in scope have girth three except R_{2,2}, which has girth four.

Cappelle et al. 2021/2022, Theorems 2.2 and 3.5: necessary local condition for arbitrary graphs and classification of P4-tidy graphs. They can cover some small cases but not the general two-parameter family.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither broad theorem subsumes the all-code rook classification. The necessary condition in general graphs is not a sufficient code identifier in graphs with four-cycles, and the P4-tidy family does not cover arbitrary rook graph dimensions. The already-covered tiny cases are not independently presented as new results.

originality.rationale: The classification concerns all open-independent open-locating-dominating sets of rectangular rook graphs, not just a minimum size. Seo–Slater (2017) establishes the definition and high-girth criterion, inapplicable to these graphs (triangles or a four-cycle); Cappelle et al. (arXiv:2103.07972, §§1–4) treats necessary conditions and other graph classes but not the bipartite two-edge-path covering and exact enumeration. Search results for exact synonyms and edge-code/path-factor reductions identified no dominating formula. The absence of indexed matches is not proof of uniqueness; differently termed prior work remains a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently formulated result on distinguishing edge sets of complete bipartite graphs or P3-factors may cover some or all of the characterization.

value.rationale: A natural infinite two-parameter line-graph family receives a complete existence and every-code classification, closed labeled enumerator, and a unique cardinality polynomial. Arithmetic obstructions for square boards and sharp one-unused-vertex exceptional ratios are structural and previously not implied by the inspected source theorems. This serves the original fault-location motivation for open-independent OLD codes rather than an artificial parameter evaluation.
